owner_decision.summary: The ledger avoids creative-target decomposition by classifying both figurative/editorial spans as standalone real-world commitments, which mechanically permits an empty target-audit collection and COMPLETE coverage.

findings: The combined shadow/light clause is an integrated figurative construction, not a neutralized smallest real-world proposition.
The commitment merely copies the candidate span and does not state the truth-evaluable proposition alleged to survive.
Financial concealment or nontransparency may survive and has governed support in the off-books salary fact, but the emitted entry uses null support and NEW_UNSUPPORTED_EVENT.
The employees-remain-in-light component is not independently adjudicated and cannot be converted into an unsupported real-world event by grouping it with the money metaphor.
Candidate modality PROPOSED does not resolve the actual communicative force of the conditional figurative clause.
The hotel-room/transparency wording is wordplay carrying a hedged editorial or normative assessment, not itself a neutralized descriptive event.
The commitment again copies the candidate span rather than identifying a smallest surviving proposition.
Any presupposition of insufficient transparency requires independent adjudication; it cannot be labeled wholesale as a standalone NEW_UNSUPPORTED_EVENT.
The span is part of the same integrated construction as P1, yet the ledger provides no creative host or overlap relationship.

failure_class_definition.name: REAL_WORLD_COMMITMENT_ESCAPE_FROM_TARGET_AUDIT
failure_class_definition.definition: A ledger bypasses mandatory decomposition of materially creative language by assigning its creative spans only REAL_WORLD_COMMITMENT or UNRESOLVED_SCOPE roles, leaving no CONTAINED_CREATIVE entry to trigger target audits, while still claiming exhaustive creative and target coverage.
failure_class_definition.distinction_from_prior_failure: The prior false complete found a creative host but hid factual targets inside it. This output takes the opposite escape path: it suppresses the creative host itself so the target-audit collection may remain empty.
failure_class_definition.safety_effect: Overclassification as unsupported facts can create false rejection pressure and destroys the intended separation between nonfactual editorial transformation and factual-semantic claims.
failure_class_definition.quality_effect: Literal span copying into commitment fields provides no usable semantic decomposition despite mechanically valid records.

contract_vs_owner_evaluation.contract_validation_scope: Field order, enum tuples, graph structure, source membership, and declared coverage coherence.
contract_vs_owner_evaluation.owner_evaluation_scope: Whether emitted roles and commitments correctly and exhaustively represent candidate communicative force.
contract_vs_owner_evaluation.conclusion: STAGE_P_VALID does not establish semantic correctness or eligibility for Stage C.

recommended_next_step: Owner-review and freeze this classification, then separately authorize design-only failure analysis for preventing creative-host suppression without forcing every candidate or every figurative phrase into a creative role.
